notes: The hunter's kits (v9.7). Both weapons change the look (guard pictures w0guard / w1guard): the charge blade (a sword in the right hand, its big shield on the left arm), then the gunlance (a huge lance with a gun barrel, a tower shield on the left arm). Their states are generated too. Phial bursts, shell blasts and explosions are drawn by the game; the discharge, the shell shot and both ultimates keep their clips.

0.held: the charge blade's sword in his right hand and its big shield on his left arm
0.subject: a Monster Hunter warrior in spiky red-and-black Rathalos armour with a horned helmet, holding a charge blade: a long sword in his right hand and a big shield on his left arm
0.guard_pose: ready stance facing right, the charge blade's sword held forward in his right hand, its big shield on his left arm
0.air_pose: in mid-air facing right, knees tucked, the sword in his right hand, the big shield on his left arm

w0_shield: braces to block: raises the big shield on his left arm in front of his body and crouches slightly behind it, the sword held ready in his right hand, a solid defensive guard
w0_jab: first hit of a fast three-hit sword combo: a quick diagonal downward slash of the sword from high in front of him to low in front of him, a thin crisp blade trail, the shield kept on his left arm, then back into the stance
w0_jab2: second hit: a fast return stroke, the sword swept back up across in front of him at chest height, a thin crisp blade trail, then back into the stance
w0_jab3: finisher: spins once on the spot and swings the sword in a wide powerful rising roundslash from low in front of him up over his head, yellow sparks of energy crackling along the blade, then back into the stance
w0_nair: air combo in mid-air: slashes the sword down in front of him, then spins and cuts in a full circle around his body, a thin crisp blade trail, then back to the tucked pose
w0_sspecial: charged thrust: crouches low, then lunges forward and stabs the sword straight ahead at full arm extension, the blade crackling with yellow energy, the shield held at his side, then back into the stance
w0_uspecial: rising slash: crouches, then leaps straight up swinging the sword in a big rising arc over his head, the blade crackling with yellow energy, rising the whole time, ending in mid-air with the sword raised
w0_dspecial: guard point: raises the big shield in front of his body and braces behind it, perfectly still, then bashes forward with the shield, then back into the stance. Only the hunter and his weapon are drawn: no explosion, no effect

1.held: the huge gunlance in his right hand and its big tower shield on his left arm
1.subject: a Monster Hunter warrior in spiky red-and-black Rathalos armour with a horned helmet, holding a huge gunlance (a long lance with a gun barrel along it) in his right hand and a big tower shield on his left arm
1.guard_pose: ready stance facing right, the huge gunlance held in his right hand pointing forward, the big tower shield on his left arm
1.air_pose: in mid-air facing right, knees tucked, the gunlance in his right hand, the tower shield on his left arm

w1_shield: braces to block: raises the big tower shield on his left arm in front of his body and crouches behind it, the gunlance resting on the shield pointing forward, a solid defensive guard
w1_jab: first hit of a three-hit lance combo: a quick straight thrust of the gunlance forward at chest height at full arm extension, then back into the stance
w1_jab2: second hit: steps in with a second, longer thrust of the gunlance straight forward at chest height, then back into the stance
w1_jab3: finisher: swings the gunlance in a wide upward sweep from low in front of him up over his head, a burst of orange fire and smoke from its tip as it fires a shell, then back into the stance
w1_nair: air combo in mid-air: thrusts the gunlance diagonally down in front of him, then straight forward, then back to the tucked pose
w1_sspecial: guard dash: charges forward hunched behind the big tower shield, the gunlance pointing forward over it, then thrusts the lance forward at the end, then back into the stance
w1_uspecial: blast dash: points the gunlance straight down at the ground, fires it and is blasted straight up into the air, rising the whole time, the lance still pointing down below him. Only the hunter and his weapon are drawn: no explosion, no fire
w1_dspecial: full burst: braces behind the tower shield, points the gunlance forward and fires all its shells at once with a strong recoil that rocks him back, then back into the stance. Only the hunter and his weapon are drawn: no explosion, no fire
